sn14.34:1.2: Pathavīdhātu ce hidaṃ bhikkhave ekantadukkhā abhavissa dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena || nayidam sattā pathavīdhātuyā sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn14.34:1.3: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave pathavīdhātusukhā sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena || tasmā sattā pathavīdhātuyā sārajjanti || || 3
sn14.34:2.3: Vāyodhātu ce hidam bhikkhave ekantadukkhā abhavissa dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena || na yidam sattā vāyodhātuyā sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn14.34:2.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave vāyodhātu sukhā sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena || tasmā sattā vāyodhātuyā sārajjanti || || 6
sn14.34:3.1: Pathavīdhātu ce hidaṃ bhikkhave ekantasukhā abhavissa sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena || na yidaṃ sattā pathavīdhātuyā nibbindeyyuṃ || ||
sn14.34:3.2: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave pathavīdhātu dukkhā dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena || tasmā sattā pathavīdhātuyā nibbindanti || || 7
sn14.34:4.3: Vāyodhātu ce hidaṃ bhikkhave ekantasukhā abhavissa sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena || nayidam sattā vāyodhātuyā nibbindeyyuṃ || ||
sn14.34:4.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave vāyodhātu dukkhā dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena || tasmā sattā vāyodhātuyā nibbindantīti || ||
